List the PACs and their chemical properties

Source: R/pac-list.R
pac_list.Rd

Returns the polycyclic aromatic compounds (PACs) available in the package, with the chemical properties used to calculate narcotic benchmarks and guidelines. Values of log KOW are from EPI Suite KOWWIN, compiled by CCME, and are capped at 6.0.

Usage

pac_list(app_only = FALSE)

Arguments

app_only

If TRUE, only return the PACs displayed in the Shiny app.

Value

A data frame with columns:

  • chemical: the chemical name, as accepted by functions such as narcotic_benchmark() and p_abs().

  • pac: the PAC or PAC homologue group name.

  • chem_class: the chemical class: "PAH", "He" (heterocyclic aromatic compound), or "oxy-PAH".

  • log_kow: log KOW.

  • mol_weight: molecular weight (g/mol).

  • app: whether the PAC is displayed in the Shiny app.

  • ref: the source of the values.

Details

PAC homologue groups that combine more than one parent, such as "C1-Phenanthrenes/Anthracenes", have one row per parent (e.g., "c1-phenanthrenes" and "c1-anthracenes"), with the same properties.

Examples

pac_list()
#>                      chemical                                pac chem_class

#> 2            1-methylchrysene                   1-Methylchrysene        PAH
